title: Facebook Group Posts & All Photos Scraper
description: Scrape latest or historical posts from public Facebook groups as clean, agent-ready JSON. Each result is one post with text, Facebook timestamp, author data, engagement, stable post URL, and all recoverable photo URLs, including hidden +N photo sets. Supports newest-first monitoring, known-post/date boundaries, media quality flags, and cursor continuation for 5,000+ post backfills. Public groups only; no private/login-only content, expanded comments, image downloads, or video guarantee.

groupUrls.title: Facebook group URLs
groupUrls.description: Required. Public Facebook group URLs, vanity URLs, or numeric group IDs. Use group URLs only, not post URLs, Marketplace URLs, or private/login-only groups. Up to maxGroupsPerRun groups are processed inside one Actor run.

maxGroupsPerRun.title: Max groups per run
maxGroupsPerRun.description: Maximum number of groupUrls to process in one Actor run. Results and billing multiply per group. Extra group URLs are skipped and listed in SUMMARY.skippedGroupUrls.

maxPostsPerGroup.title: Max posts per group
maxPostsPerGroup.description: Maximum number of post results to return per group. Each post is one billable result: 10 groups x 1,000 posts is about 10,000 billable results. For deep historical backfills, run up to 1,000 posts, store SUMMARY.pointer.nextCursor, then continue with startCursor.

sortMode.title: Sort mode
sortMode.description: Facebook group feed sort mode. New posts first is the best fit for latest-post collection and daily monitoring.

expandAllPhotos.title: Expand all photos
expandAllPhotos.description: Recover photo URLs hidden behind Facebook +N grids when publicly available. Keep enabled for complete media rows; disable only for faster preview-only runs.

includeRawPayload.title: Include raw payload
includeRawPayload.description: Include the raw parsed Facebook payload in each dataset row. Useful for debugging, but makes output much larger.

onlyPostsNewerThan.title: Only posts newer than
onlyPostsNewerThan.description: Canonical lower date boundary (inclusive) of the [onlyPostsNewerThan, onlyPostsOlderThan) window. Return posts published at or after this Facebook timestamp. With New posts first sorting, the Actor stops after reaching older posts. Best for incremental monitoring; pair with onlyPostsOlderThan for exact time periods.

onlyPostsOlderThan.title: Only posts older than
onlyPostsOlderThan.description: Canonical upper date boundary (exclusive) of the [onlyPostsNewerThan, onlyPostsOlderThan) window. Skip posts published at or after this Facebook timestamp and continue toward older history. Combine with onlyPostsNewerThan to collect a specific time period.

knownPostIds.title: Known post IDs
knownPostIds.description: Post IDs already stored by your pipeline. With New posts first sorting, the Actor stops when it reaches one of them. Best for daily latest monitoring. State routing: daily latest monitoring -> knownPostIds; older-post backfill -> startCursor from SUMMARY.pointer.nextCursor; multi-group backfill -> startCursorsByGroup; stored pipeline state -> checkpoint. Never pass a backfill cursor into a latest run.

checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
checkpoint.description: Checkpoint object from a previous SUMMARY. Use it when your pipeline stores run state across scheduled runs. State routing: daily latest monitoring -> knownPostIds; older-post backfill -> startCursor from SUMMARY.pointer.nextCursor; multi-group backfill -> startCursorsByGroup; stored pipeline state -> checkpoint. Never pass a backfill cursor into a latest run.

startCursor.title: Start cursor
startCursor.description: Opaque cursor string from SUMMARY.pointer.nextCursor. Use it for older-post historical backfills only. Do not use yesterday's cursor to collect newer posts. State routing: daily latest monitoring -> knownPostIds; older-post backfill -> startCursor from SUMMARY.pointer.nextCursor; multi-group backfill -> startCursorsByGroup; stored pipeline state -> checkpoint. Never pass a backfill cursor into a latest run.

startCursorsByGroup.title: Start cursors by group
startCursorsByGroup.description: Optional map of group URL to GraphQL cursor for older-page backfill in multi-group runs. Prefer passing the previous SUMMARY/checkpoint when available. State routing: daily latest monitoring -> knownPostIds; older-post backfill -> startCursor from SUMMARY.pointer.nextCursor; multi-group backfill -> startCursorsByGroup; stored pipeline state -> checkpoint. Never pass a backfill cursor into a latest run.

paginationMode.title: Pagination mode
paginationMode.description: Ranked snapshot collects candidates and sorts locally by creation time. Cursor page preserves feed cursor order, emits a next pointer, and is recommended for monitoring or backfills.

maxCandidates.title: Max candidate posts
maxCandidates.description: Candidate posts collected before local sorting. Leave 0 for auto budget (about 3x maxPostsPerGroup, minimum +20). Raise only if SUMMARY reports candidate_limit_reached with posts missing.

maxPages.title: Max GraphQL pages
maxPages.description: Maximum GraphQL pagination requests after the public group bootstrap. Leave 0 for auto budget (about 0.85x maxPostsPerGroup, minimum 20). Raise only if SUMMARY reports a page cap with posts missing.

bootstrapRetries.title: Bootstrap retries
bootstrapRetries.description: Advanced. Leave the default unless a SUMMARY diagnostic names this exact knob. How many fresh proxy/session bootstrap attempts to try if Facebook returns a poor or login-walled public group page.

graphqlPageRetries.title: GraphQL page retries
graphqlPageRetries.description: Advanced. Leave the default unless a SUMMARY diagnostic names this exact knob. Retry count for transient empty/small GraphQL pagination responses.

proxyCountry.title: Proxy country
proxyCountry.description: Advanced. Leave the default unless a SUMMARY diagnostic names this exact knob. Apify proxy country code.

mediaSetRetries.title: Photo-set retries
mediaSetRetries.description: Advanced. Leave the default unless a SUMMARY diagnostic names this exact knob. Retry count for each Facebook media/set request.

mediaSetRetryDelayMs.title: Photo-set retry delay
mediaSetRetryDelayMs.description: Advanced. Leave the default unless a SUMMARY diagnostic names this exact knob. Base delay for media/set retries.

mediaExpansionConcurrency.title: Photo expansion concurrency
mediaExpansionConcurrency.description: Advanced. Leave the default unless a SUMMARY diagnostic names this exact knob. How many posts can expand Facebook media/set pages in parallel. Higher values can speed up all-photos runs but may increase transient Facebook/proxy failures.

mediaExpansionAdaptive.title: Adaptive photo expansion
mediaExpansionAdaptive.description: Advanced. Leave the default unless a SUMMARY diagnostic names this exact knob. When enabled, the Actor can lower high photo expansion concurrency back to the stable level if recent media/set expansion quality degrades.

mediaDeferredRetry.title: Deferred photo retry
mediaDeferredRetry.description: Advanced. Leave the default unless a SUMMARY diagnostic names this exact knob. Retry only suspicious photo-set rows after the main pass, before final dataset output. This improves +N coverage at a small extra runtime cost.

mediaDeferredRetryConcurrency.title: Deferred retry concurrency
mediaDeferredRetryConcurrency.description: Advanced. Leave the default unless a SUMMARY diagnostic names this exact knob. How many suspicious posts to retry in parallel during the deferred photo retry pass.

mediaDeferredRetryExtraRetries.title: Deferred retry extra attempts
mediaDeferredRetryExtraRetries.description: Advanced. Leave the default unless a SUMMARY diagnostic names this exact knob. Additional retry attempts for suspicious media/set rows during the deferred pass.

mediaDeferredRetryDelayMs.title: Deferred retry delay
mediaDeferredRetryDelayMs.description: Advanced. Leave the default unless a SUMMARY diagnostic names this exact knob. Base delay for the deferred photo retry pass.

debug.title: Debug output
debug.description: Advanced. Leave the default unless a SUMMARY diagnostic names this exact knob. Include response samples and discovery details in SUMMARY. Leave off for normal production runs.

discoverBundles.title: Discover doc_id in JS bundles
discoverBundles.description: Advanced. Leave the default unless a SUMMARY diagnostic names this exact knob. Fetch Facebook JS bundles to discover the current GraphQL doc_id. Costs extra transfer; fallback doc_id is tried either way.
